content.text: This change is a pure UI display helper: - `triageCountLabel(queueLength: number)` returns a static string like `"1 to review"`, `"7 to review"`, or `"50+ to review"`. - Input is `queue.length` (a JavaScript number from React state), which is coerced via template literal. - Output is rendered inside `{...}` — React auto-escapes text children, so no XSS sink. - No shell, SQL, filesystem, network, auth, logging, or serialization sinks are touched. - `CAPTURE_QUEUE_CAP` is a display-only constant that mirrors a server-side `.take(50)` for label rendering; it is not used to enforce any security or resource cap client-side. - The test file additions are non-production. - No sibling handlers, control regressions, allowlist expansions, or gate/action mismatches present. No security-relevant source→sink path is introduced.
